paragraphs: Pray for one another: Thanksgiving and Requests
Sing a song of praise together
Review & Accountability
To whom did you tell Jesus’ story?
Have someone teach the “Hand Gospel”
What was the topic of the last lesson? What did you learn?
(Priesthood of all Believers)

sections.title: Look Up (New Teaching)
paragraphs: Read

The church is not a building or a place we meet. The church is a group of people who follow Jesus and come together to worship Him, learn about Him, and then go out together and do what He says. We are the church!
1 Corinthians 12:12-27
Acts 2:37-47 (The Fellowship of Believers)
Tell It as a Story
Can someone tell this story in their own words?
Practice in groups of two.
Teach
The Church is made up of those who follow Jesus.
Jesus has given us all different gifts. We must use them for His glory!
Each person is equally important. No one is better than another.
As the Church, we should learn from God’s Word, pray, take the Lord’s Supper, help one another, and praise Jesus.
If we will do like the first Church did, then we will grow and many more will be added to God’s Kingdom.
Ask
What did you learn from these Scriptures?
Think a little, how will you practice what you have learned?

sections.title: Look Forward (Obedience)
paragraphs: Make a Plan
Read part 2 of this lesson. Teach everyone how to draw a healthy church map. Decide together if your group is a healthy church.
Let’s be a healthy church that goes out and does what we learn together from God’s Word.
Follow the example found in Acts 2.
Continue sharing the gospel with your family and friends! To whom will you tell your testimony and Jesus’ story?
Vision Casting
God’s Word tells us that if we love Him, we will obey His commands. Let our love for God lead us to obey His word!
John 14:15
Pray
Ask God to help us learn His Word and then do what it says. May we be people who always obey Jesus.
